definitions.explanation: The seventh planet from the Sun in the solar system. An ice giant with a distinctive blue-green color, known for its extreme axial tilt.

examples.japanese: {天王星|てんのうせい}は{太陽|たいよう}から{七|なな}{番目|ばんめ}の{惑星|わくせい}だ。
examples.english: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun.

examples.japanese: {天王星|てんのうせい}は{青|あお}っぽい{色|いろ}をしている。
{天王星|てんのうせい}は{自転軸|じてんじく}が{大|おお}きく{傾|かたむ}いていることで{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Uranus is known for its greatly tilted axis of rotation.

notes:
The name literally means "sky king star" — from {天|てん} (heaven/sky) + {王|おう} (king) + {星|せい} (star/planet). The Japanese planet names follow a pattern using the five Chinese elements plus additional characters for the outer planets discovered later.

The eight planets in Japanese:
- {水星|すいせい}: Mercury
- {金星|きんせい}: Venus
- {地球|ちきゅう}: Earth
- {火星|かせい}: Mars
- {木星|もくせい}: Jupiter
- {土星|どせい}: Saturn
- {天王星|てんのうせい}: Uranus
- {海王星|かいおうせい}: Neptune

Note: {天王星|てんのうせい} sounds similar to {天皇制|てんのうせい} (the emperor system), but they are written with different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天王星|てんのうせい}の{輪|わ}: the rings of Uranus
- {天王星|てんのうせい}の{衛星|えいせい}: the moons of Uranus
- {天王星|てんのうせい}を{観測|かんそく}する: to observe Uranus
